stations.title: Ambrose
stations.note: It is the end of the month.

stations.title: Loops by hand
stations.text: A loop for each question, each a new chance.

captions: At the end of the month Ambrose wants the total, the largest bill and the bills in order.
Every question means another loop written by hand, each with its own chance of a slip.
You hand the bills to the standard library's own tools, in five tasks.
Now the month is added up, searched, counted and sorted by tools that are already tested.
The workshop's lists are summed, searched, counted and sorted by the library now.
